info.title: adomcp
info.description: AdoMCP Server — MCP server for database schema discovery and SQL execution (SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Oracle).

options.description: Set the default write policy for dynamic connections and static connections without an override. Omit to use AllowAnySql from configuration (default false).
